baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive participial ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ at word 2 is rooted in ق ر ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The demonstrative identifies a set whose distance has been reduced by an unstated agent; the form marks conferred relational placement rather than self-achieved approach.

activation_trace.role: Literal nearness as the opposite of distance supplies reduced relational distance as the model's core.

changed_reading.after: Those are the specifically identified people who have been brought into nearness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The title ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ at word 2 directly admits the ق ر ب branch of royal intimates.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nearness can be social access: an admitted inner circle distinguished by favor and proximity to sovereign power.

activation_trace.role: The literal royal-favorite and inner-circle image turns unspecified nearness into privileged access.

changed_reading.after: Nearness is admission to an intimate, privileged circle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event lowers and raises, while the ر ف ع inventory itself includes bringing near and advancing; passive ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ therefore becomes the promoted result of a comprehensive reassignment.

activation_trace.role: Reduced distance supplies the endpoint produced by the event's opposed movements.
Literal lowering after height supplies the downward pole of the sorting action.
Raising as bringing near and advancing supplies promotion as the upward pole.

structural_cues: 56:1-6 move from an unavoidable occurrence through lowering and raising to the pulverizing and dispersal of stable terrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed lowering/raising and a raising branch that includes advancement; I infer that the event actively reassigns rank and distance, though vertical elevation alone remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The near ones occupy a static privileged distance.
changed_reading.after: They are those actively advanced into nearness by the event that overturns prior positions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience is sorted into three classes, the third completed by the repeatedly named foremost; the following demonstrative converts precedence into the title of admitted nearness.

activation_trace.role: The royal inner-circle image supplies the access-status conferred on the identified group.
A literal kind or class supplies categorical sorting rather than pair-bonding.
The third as completer reserves a distinct final class for the ensuing identification.
Repeated literal precedence supplies the defining action of the class granted access.

structural_cues: 56:8-9 name two classes symmetrically; 56:10 breaks that symmetry with a doubled designation immediately before أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threefold classification, doubled precedence, and the adjacent demonstrative; I infer that precedence issues in nearness, while simple co-reference without a causal arrow remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The near ones are an unexplained elite.
changed_reading.after: They are the third class whose enacted precedence is answered by admission to the intimate circle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following prepositional location gives nearness an inhabitable texture: protected garden-space joined to a fitting, pleasant condition.

activation_trace.role: Relational nearness supplies the status whose lived setting is then disclosed.
The literally tree-screened garden supplies protected spatial enclosure to nearness.
A fitting place and pleasant stay supplies nearness with experiential suitability.

structural_cues: The فِى phrase of 56:12 follows the focus title without an intervening subject change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protected garden, fitting stay, and immediate locative continuation; I infer that the environment realizes the status, though it may instead be a separate reward attached to it.

changed_reading.after: Nearness is inhabited as protected placement in a fitting and pleasant domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near ones resolve into a gathered cohort unevenly distributed across time: numerous among the earlier and scarce among the later.

activation_trace.role: The privileged circle supplies the collective whose historical composition is counted.
A literally assembled company turns the title into a cohort rather than isolated persons.
Beginning and temporal precedence locate the cohort's denser portion among earlier people.
Literal paucity supplies the later cohort's reduced density.
Later-than-the-first supplies the contrasting temporal population.

structural_cues: 56:13-14 form a balanced many-earlier/few-later distribution immediately after the focus location.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an assembled company and an explicit temporal quantity contrast; I infer that both lines partition the near ones, while they could more narrowly partition only the garden's occupants.

changed_reading.before: The near ones are an undifferentiated elite.
changed_reading.after: They are a transhistorical cohort whose concentration thins sharply from earlier to later people.

context_deltas.mechanism: Close-woven supports, reclining, and reciprocal facing turn nearness from a merely radial relation to power into lateral proximity among the near ones themselves.

activation_trace.role: Literal reduced distance supplies the relation redistributed across the assembly.
A place of settled reclining supplies the assembly's stable social platform.
Things stacked in close order supply compact arrangement rather than scattered privilege.
Literal leaning and reliance supply a posture of settled ease.
A group turning toward one another supplies reciprocal face-to-face sociality.

structural_cues: 56:15-16 progress from support, through posture, to mutual orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compact furnishing and reciprocal orientation; I infer a social topology in which members are near one another, though the details could remain furniture and posture without redefining the title.

changed_reading.before: They are individually close to a superior center.
changed_reading.after: They are also formed into a compact, mutually facing community of nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attendants circulate around the group, provision flows from a spring, and selection follows their preference; the courtly near ones become a serviced center with real agency.

activation_trace.role: The privileged inner-circle image supplies the status embodied by surrounding service.
Literal circulation around something places the near ones at the service pattern's center.
A flowing water-source supplies sustained provision to the centered group.
Literal choosing supplies preference agency rather than passive receipt alone.

structural_cues: 56:17-21 repeatedly marks service directed عَلَيْهِمْ and provisions selected or desired by them; branchless ن ز ف in 56:19 adds absence of depletion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies orbiting service, a flowing source, and choice; I infer that these spatial and volitional relations enact privileged centrality, though they may be consequences rather than definitions of nearness.

changed_reading.before: The privileged circle is only a status label.
changed_reading.after: The near ones occupy a durable service center whose provisions answer their choices.

context_deltas.mechanism: Explicit recompense for intentional work makes conferred nearness answer prior action rather than read as unexplained favoritism.

activation_trace.role: Passive brought-near status supplies the conferred outcome whose basis is disclosed.
Literal matching of deed with recompense supplies an answer relation between action and placement.
Intentional action supplies the antecedent to which the conferred state responds.

structural_cues: 56:24 retrospectively labels the preceding state and provisions as recompense for what they used to do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense explicitly tied to work; I infer that brought-near status belongs inside that recompense, though the causal clause could scope only the amenities of 56:12-23.

changed_reading.before: They are brought near by unexplained selection.
changed_reading.after: Their conferred nearness is an answering placement corresponding to intentional action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Negated worthless or incriminating speech and the doubled exception of peace make nearness an interactional environment whose members do not damage one another by language.

activation_trace.role: Reduced relational distance supplies the close social field whose speech is regulated.
Literal auditory reception frames the environment by what can enter its members' hearing.
False or ugly speech supplies the excluded form of verbal proximity.
Loading or imputing sin supplies the excluded accusatory effect of speech.
Uttered speech supplies the sole positive channel admitted by the exception.
Repeated safety and freedom from harm supplies reciprocal peace as the content of closeness.

structural_cues: 56:25 negates two speech classes; 56:26 replaces them through an exception and repeats سَلَٰمًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an auditory exclusion and doubled peace-speech; I infer that safe reciprocity characterizes nearness itself, while the verses may only describe its surrounding etiquette.

changed_reading.after: Nearness is also a close social condition in which harmful speech is absent and peace is reciprocated.

activation_trace.role: Mounts drawn near and honored supply an equine image of rewarded finishers.
Literal racing and precedence activates the neighboring mount image and supplies the outstripping action.

changed_reading.before: The foremost are then called near.
changed_reading.after: Race imagery overlays the sequence: those who outstrip are like honored mounts drawn close after the advance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it reads nearness through a night journey toward water; it remains anchored in a focus ق ر ب branch and the later flowing spring, but it should be qualified as a material analogy rather than a claim about the participle's ordinary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ at 56:11 word 2 includes movement toward a watering place.

activation_trace.role: Travel toward water and urgent approach to the resource supplies an arrival-at-source model.
The literal flowing spring supplies the destination that makes the watering-place branch newly visible.

changed_reading.before: They are brought near to an unspecified center.
changed_reading.after: They can be imaged as a cohort brought successfully to the sustaining source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و ل ي mapping supplied for ء و ل; it remains valid as a packet-resolved branch that directly echoes focus nearness, but prose should mark it as a split-root activation rather than the primary sense of ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ق ر ب branch of reduced distance is echoed by a supplied secondary mapping for 56:13 word 3.

activation_trace.role: Literal nearness supplies the focus relation that the split context mapping reactivates.
Near succession without an intervening gap supplies a continuous earlier chain entering the near cohort.
Literal fewness supplies the later thinning of that otherwise continuous chain.

changed_reading.before: Earlier and later people are merely counted within the near group.
changed_reading.after: A split-root echo images earlier entrants as a near, gapless succession whose continuity becomes sparse later.

strongest_changes: Passive nearness becomes active promotion within the event's lowering-and-raising reversal.
Repeated precedence becomes the action answered by intimate access.
Close-woven, face-to-face seating redistributes nearness among the members themselves.
Recompense ties conferred nearness to prior intentional work.
summary.what_was_special: The focus title unfolded as promoted rank, mutual social topology, serviced centrality, and protected speech; equine, watering-place, and split-root succession branches remained live under explicit exploratory containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The unstated agent and precise center of nearness remain unspecified in the focus wording.
The following rewards may realize the meaning of nearness or merely accompany it.
The causal arrow from precedence and work to nearness is strongly sequenced but not grammatically stated inside 56:11.
